project.name: Queue status UI
project.brief: Fresh prospective CF-07 integration evaluation over retained production art; original allocation and evidence are historical inputs.

included: Original brief, shared source, all five exact art files and source-linked normative clauses retained.
Fresh prospective allocation and store, not a continuation of ignored original producer state.
Stable renderer and wrapper established before the controlled Working-only timing change.
excluded: New art, provider execution, remote account badge registry, and changes to unrelated assets.

queue.purpose: Show failed work and the Retry action in both full and compact status cells with a shape that remains distinguishable without color.
queue.next: Preserve exact existing art and allocation; no new production in this evaluation.

asset.purpose: Show failed work and the Retry action in both full and compact status cells with a shape that remains distinguishable without color.

consumers.usage: Maps failed to the Retry label, current assets/error-retry.png path and one static frame.

Compact status consumer returns the same failed descriptor; reuse one asset.

existing.role: Exact retained art; historical origin is not current evaluation acceptance.

requirements.reason: BRIEF fixes logical status cells and display.cell agrees.
BRIEF explicitly requires transparent status backgrounds; it does not restrict alpha to binary values.

requirements.value: Readable pixel-art silhouettes at 1x and 3x nearest-neighbor display scale.
requirements.reason: BRIEF requires both inspection scales; display uses scale 3 and nearest filtering.
display.background is the supplied dark-panel color; use it for future previews.

requirements.value: Use the existing cool blue UI accent; no fixed palette is required.
requirements.reason: Preserves the explicit direction without imposing a palette count or exact color rejection rule.
The preserved Start SVG uses this fill; it is a concrete color cue, not an approved pixel-art style sample.

Scoped caller decision under RENDER-STAGE after independent visual/contract/render comparison; this is a new adopted project choice,not an original brief requirement or upstream provider-quality result.
Retry is static and occupies one 16 by 16 logical cell.

requirements.value: Signal failed work / retry and remain distinguishable from the other statuses without color alone.
requirements.reason: BRIEF explicitly requires non-color differentiation for error/retry; failed maps to Retry.

requirements.value: A return/retry arrow with a distinct silhouette is a proposal; avoid a shape that could be confused with the Working activity loop.
requirements.reason: The exact error/retry symbol is not specified and must be judged alongside the other statuses.

requirements.value: Paused must be distinguishable from activity, completion and retry without relying on color alone.
requirements.reason: The updated brief adds a non-color distinction requirement for the Paused status; compare the family together during review.

requirements.value: The current failure visual destination is assets/error-retry.png; the established queue.retry asset identity and failure/retry purpose are unchanged.
requirements.reason: The updated brief states that the failure visual moved while its purpose stayed unchanged; statusVisuals.failed supplies the new path. Previous allocation bytes remain in PLAR history.
